lede: Texas Tech carries the stronger underlying team rating — +7.2 against +1.4, a 5.8-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas Tech -14.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Texas Tech winning 83% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where Texas Tech leads Houston by 50 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 73% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
